messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED - CI/Deploy failures impacting hotfix pipelines. Multiple alerts: GitHub Actions API errors + GitHub Packages (npm) 503s. Paging @sre-oncall-mike and eng-oncall rotation. See https://www.githubstatus.com/ for updates

sre-oncall-mike: acknowledging, looking. Can someone paste failing job logs? Are we seeing API 500s or auth failures?

alex: copying relevant log, job starts then immediately errors out when requesting actions API token: 
```
Error: Request failed with status code 500
GET https://api.github.com/orgs/redwood/actions/runs/12345 -> 500
PUT https://npm.pkg.github.com/: 503 Service Unavailable
```
We've got both Actions and Packages failing. This blocks our hotfix build-and-publish flow for private packages and also blocks GH Actions runners from obtaining workflow metadata.

deploy-bot: Automated rollout paused: pending CI artifacts unavailable. Queued releases: r-inference-hotfix-2026-03-15 (3 deploy jobs)

joan: customer-impact summary: no user-facing inference degradation yet, but customers attempting to deploy hotfixes (dedicated/private customers + a small number of hosted infra infra-changes) cannot push updates. Support tickets from two enterprise customers trying to apply security patches. Escalate priority.

pradeep: mitigation brainstorm: we can (A) build artifacts locally and upload to our internal artifact store (s3-backed mirror) and trigger deploys directly, or (B) use self-hosted runners with cached actions if runners can access repo metadata without GH Actions API (likely still blocked). Option A seems more robust right now.

sara: I can stand up a manual build on my laptop / internal build box and push the docker images to our ECR. Steps I propose: 
1) clone the release branch locally 
2) run make release to build binaries and docker images 
3) tag as r-inference-hotfix-2026-03-15-manual 
4) push to internal ECR and create a deploy via our console CLI.
Commands (internal):
```
git fetch origin release/hotfix-2026-03-15 && git checkout -b hotfix-local origin/release/hotfix-2026-03-15
make release
docker tag r-inference:latest 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/r-inference:hotfix-manual-20260315
aws s3 cp ./artifacts/hotfix.tar s3://redwood-internal-artifacts/hotfix-20260315.tar --acl bucket-owner-full-control
redwoodctl deploy create --image 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/r-inference:hotfix-manual-20260315 --env prod --note "manual workaround - GH Actions outage"
```
Security: we'll need a short-lived deploy token for redwoodctl and ECR push. tagging @security-oncall for quick approval on scoped token.

security-oncall: approved scoped token with expiration in 2 hours (token id: tmp-deploy-20260315). Use only for this manual push. Rotate after. Ensure audit log entry when done.

sre-oncall-mike: good. Alex, please validate that the manually-pushed image is compatible with our rolling update strategy (health checks, prestop hooks, etc). If yes, run canary to 5% first.

alex: validated the image locally against our health probe. Canary plan: 5% for 15 minutes, autocutover to 50% if no errors. Commands below to trigger canary via operator API (we'll do via console since GH Actions blocked):
```
# create canary rollout
redwoodctl rollout create --service inference-api --image 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/r-inference:hotfix-manual-20260315 --strategy canary --canary-percent 5 --canary-duration 15m --note "manual-hotfix - GH Actions outage"
```

joan: pinging account leads for the two enterprise customers who opened tickets to let them know we're working around GH outage and will attempt manual deploys. Draft message queued.

pradeep: additional note: our package registry mirrors (internal npm proxy) have a stale cache for the hotfix package. If package publish via GH Packages was required for the build step, bypass by using our prebuilt binary/wheels and mounting them into the image build, or push package tarball to internal mirror S3 location and update package.json to point to internal URL.

sara: I'm starting the build on build-box-07 now (ssh: build-box-07). ETA ~12 minutes. I'll post artifacts link when done.

incident-bot: GitHub status update fetched at +4m: 
- GitHub Actions: Major outage.
- GitHub Packages (npm): Degraded/Service Unavailable.
See https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/abcd-efgh for details.

alex: temporary process docs for on-call: 
- If GH Actions blocks critical hotfix: escalate to SRE lead, get scoped deploy token from security-oncall, produce manual artifact (image or tarball), push to internal artifact store/ECR, trigger redwoodctl rollout with canary, monitor metrics (latency, error rate, token-scope audit).
- Avoid publishing to public registries while outage persists.

sre-oncall-mike: Handoff note for next on-call (alex taking over): I've run initial triage, approved manual deploy route and coordinated token. Alex will be the primary until resolved.

alex: taking over on-call. I'll monitor builds and parity of artifacts. Sara, please post the artifact S3 path once upload completes.

sara: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-internal-artifacts/hotfix-20260315.tar (sha256: 6b1f9c...). Pushing image to ECR now.

deploy-bot: Manual deploy queued by alex: rollout id rdo-20260315-77. Canary started at 1773001650.

alex: canary metrics after 5 minutes: healthy. Error rate 0.05% (baseline 0.04%). Latency unchanged. Proceeding to 50% per canary policy.

joan: notified customers about manual deploy attempt and ETA. Support ticket notes updated.

incident-bot: GitHub status update fetched at +30m: Actions still degraded, Packages intermittent. No ETA posted.

pradeep: ops note for post-incident: we should pre-seed internal artifact mirror with built binaries for critical services so we can skip GH Packages during external outages. Also add a playbook step for manual-prod-build and ECR push. Filing follow-up task after incident.

sre-oncall-mike: filing an incident follow-up. Assigning to pradeep for mitigation plan and to devex to document manual deploy runbook.

alex: deploy completed to 100% at 1773002010. Monitoring ongoing. Please keep an eye on customer tickets.

sara: confirmed app instances pulling new image, health checks green. Nice work team. :shipit:

joan: closing loop with customers that were blocked. Will reopen if they report problems.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: "mitigated - external dependency (GitHub) causing CI/publish failures, manual deploy workaround applied". Will keep incident open until GH status returns to normal and we validate pipeline restores.

sre-oncall-mike: thanks everyone. Next steps: postmortem, add pre-seeded artifacts, playbook updates, audit token usage. Handoff completed to alex.

alex: acknowledged. I'll run a quick regression test overnight and author the incident notes.

security-oncall: reminder - rotate the tmp-deploy-20260315 token now that deploy finished. Audit logs show single usage by sara and one redwoodctl call by alex.

joan: adding labels: sev-2, external-dependency, github-actions-outage, manual-mitigation.

sara: closing local build box session. If GH comes back we can re-enable CI and re-run a full clean build to ensure parity.

end of thread.
